name: Matthew Parker
source:
Usually called Matt for short. He has recently transferred to Riley's school as a substitute calculus teacher. He's given the nickname "Brutalus Calculi" by Megan. His real occupation is as a hydrologist. He is also the adviser of Riley's computer club at school.
Mr. Parker can be found on the rooftop.
